notes.title: New Update Available for PC and Mac!
notes.content:
Farming World has received an update with the following changes:

- Added additional hotkeys, 1/2/3/4 now control time
- Rival has been given a boost and now expand faster
- Markets now favour organic over non-organic foods
- Property market has been inflated and building prices have been increased
- Current market prices for meats have been decreased
- Challenges are a little more challenging
- Prices of items are now viewable before unlocking them

notes.title: Farming World Update 0.01 Now Live for PC & Mac
notes.content:
Farming World has been updated for both PC & Mac. The update includes arrow key scrolling, auto feed for animals and currency assigned to specific regions. The full list is below:

· Added an auto feed button to animal pens
· Added ability to buy rented property without having to plough the field first
· All menus now pause the game when opened
· Different countries now have localised currencies
· Arrow keys can now be used to move around the map
· The tutorial has been modified to make it easier to progress through
· AM/PM text overlay in log messages fix
